episodes.153655: Outer rain bands from Tropical Storm Eta produced showers and gusty winds along the Indian River and Saint Lucie County coasts.
episodes.154135: Very deep tropical moisture pulled up by the circulation of Tropical Cyclone Eta as it was moving across Cuba and into Southern Florida moved over the area. As a result, environmental conditions were very favorable for multiple days of heavy shower activity. A tropical wave was also injected into Eta's moisture plume, further enhancing the moisture content across the local area between 11/10 and 11/11.
episodes.154279: An upper level trough brought notable lower elevation rain and mountain snow across Southern California from November 7th - 9th. The cold nature of the system also brought chilly temperatures to the region, especially in areas of the High Desert.
episodes.154553: Tropical Depression Eta was located east of Belize while moving north-northeast, while a deep upper trough extended through the eastern Gulf of Mexico. Strong high pressure over the western Atlantic produced a zone of accelerated boundary layer easterlies over the Florida Straits. Despite dry mid-altitude layers, shallow squalls developed and produced isolated gale-force wind gusts over the eastern Straits of Florida.
